authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Full tanu/tanuka explicitly includes Hindi tanuk/tanak/tanik “small”. The selected few/quantity responses preserve that whole adjective, with source vowel length and internal transcription space retained; the ordinary small-to-few use is compatible with the entry’s Pali thin/small senses. Longer -yākā and nīkanā forms are not reduced to this stem.
